lines.zh: 我沿着墓碑走，数着名字。
lines.en: I walk the headstones, counting names.

lines.zh: 靴子踩过枯草，声音很轻。
lines.en: My boots cross the dry grass, quietly.

lines.zh: 这条地下走廊，我走了几百遍。
lines.en: I've walked this crypt corridor hundreds of times.

lines.zh: 骨匕首挂在腰上，走路会碰响。
lines.en: The bone dagger at my hip knocks as I walk.

lines.zh: 我从鬼屋的侧门绕过去。
lines.en: I slip around the haunted house's side door.

lines.zh: 二十四步，正好到祭坛。
lines.en: Twenty-four steps to the altar. Exactly.

lines.zh: 泥土下面有更旧的路。
lines.en: Beneath the soil lie older roads.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，从不奔跑。
lines.en: I walk steadily. I never run.

lines.zh: 墓园的铁栅栏缺了一根。
lines.en: The graveyard fence is missing one bar.

lines.zh: 我绕过新坟，那里还没安静。
lines.en: I skirt the fresh grave; it isn't quiet yet.

lines.zh: 灯油快烧完了，我得走快点。
lines.en: The lamp oil is low; I should hurry.

lines.zh: 巡完这一圈，我就去守夜。
lines.en: After this round, I keep the vigil.

lines.zh: 我从不睡觉，睡下就会有人来。
lines.en: I never sleep; sleeping invites visitors.

lines.zh: 我在数蜡烛，少了一根。
lines.en: I'm counting candles. One is missing.

lines.zh: 骨头匕首的刃口该磨了。
lines.en: The bone dagger's edge needs honing.

lines.zh: 土层下有指甲刮擦的声音。
lines.en: Nails are scraping under the soil.

lines.zh: 第三夜了，我的眼睛发干。
lines.en: Third night now; my eyes are dry.

lines.zh: 我念完这段，就该有人来了。
lines.en: Once I finish this passage, someone will come.

lines.zh: 堕落精华在我口袋里发烫。
lines.en: The fallen essence burns in my pocket.

lines.zh: 我把歪掉的十字架扶正。
lines.en: I straighten a cross that had tilted.

lines.zh: 墓园的门该上锁了。
lines.en: The graveyard gate should be locked.

lines.zh: 安静，我喜欢这种安静。
lines.en: Quiet. I like this kind of quiet.

lines.zh: 你站在坟前，没有献花。
lines.en: You stand at a grave with no flowers.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，我记住了。
lines.en: Your eyes. I've remembered them.

lines.zh: 别假装是来扫墓的。
lines.en: Don't pretend you came to tend graves.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的是铁剑吗？
lines.en: Is that an iron sword in your hand?

lines.zh: 我看了你三夜了。
lines.en: I've watched you for three nights.

lines.zh: 你不睡，我也没睡。
lines.en: You don't sleep. Neither do I.

lines.zh: 站远一点，你踩到坟了。
lines.en: Stand back; you're treading on a grave.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很响，这里太静。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud here.

lines.zh: 来过的人，我都记在本子上。
lines.en: I write down everyone who visits.

lines.zh: 你的手上有铁傀儡的锈味。
lines.en: Your hands smell of iron golem rust.

lines.zh: 两刀而已，我的甲还挡得住。
lines.en: Two cuts in; my armor still holds.

lines.zh: 我往后挪了半步，脸朝你。
lines.en: I shifted back half a step, still facing you.

lines.zh: 骨甲裂了一道，无妨。
lines.en: The bone armor cracked. No matter.

lines.zh: 你比上一个更有力气。
lines.en: You hit harder than the last one.

lines.zh: 伤口里落出来的是墓土。
lines.en: What falls from the wound is grave dirt.

lines.zh: 你的手劲，我记在骨头里。
lines.en: Your strength is written in my bones.

lines.zh: 单膝落地，我又撑起来。
lines.en: One knee hit the ground; I pushed back up.

lines.zh: 活人才喊疼，我不喊。
lines.en: Only the living cry out. I don't.

lines.zh: 我抓紧匕首，手指发白。
lines.en: I grip the dagger until my fingers pale.

lines.zh: 再来，墓园的位置很多。
lines.en: Again. The graveyard has plenty of room.

lines.zh: 供品放下，人退后三步。
lines.en: Leave the offering and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 活人碰过的食物，我不碰。
lines.en: I don't touch food a living hand has held.

lines.zh: 面包？坟里的人更需要。
lines.en: Bread? The ones below need it more.

lines.zh: 你把金苹果收起来吧。
lines.en: Put that golden apple away.

lines.zh: 供品要摆在石台上，不是手里。
lines.en: Offerings go on the stone, not in your hand.

lines.zh: 我只要堕落精华，别的不碰。
lines.en: I want only fallen essence; nothing else.

lines.zh: 别用食物换路，这里没有路。
lines.en: Don't trade food for passage; there is none.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里的面包味。
lines.en: I smell bread in your pocket.

lines.zh: 拿走，我不收活人的礼。
lines.en: Take it away; I don't accept gifts from the living.

lines.zh: 留着你的东西，留着你的命。
lines.en: Keep your goods, and keep your life.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我的护甲是骨做的。
lines.en: Don't touch me; my armor is bone.

lines.zh: 你撞到石碑，碑倒了。
lines.en: You knocked the headstone over.

lines.zh: 让开，我要过这条走廊。
lines.en: Move; I need this corridor.

lines.zh: 我的匕首离你的肋骨很近。
lines.en: My dagger is very close to your ribs.

lines.zh: 踩到我的袍角了，松脚。
lines.en: You're on my robe. Step off.

lines.zh: 你的甲响得整条墓道都听见。
lines.en: Your armor echoes down the whole crypt.

lines.zh: 墓园的路窄，一次过一人。
lines.en: The path is narrow; one at a time.

lines.zh: 别在我背后呼吸。
lines.en: Don't breathe behind my back.

lines.zh: 我退开了，这是给你的机会。
lines.en: I stepped aside. That was your chance.

lines.zh: 土地不喜欢被踩两次。
lines.en: The ground dislikes being trodden twice.

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，只轮班守夜。
lines.en: We don't pair off; we take shifts.

lines.zh: 墓园里没有婚约，只有名单。
lines.en: There are no vows here, only lists.

lines.zh: 同伴都埋在东边的墙下。
lines.en: My companions are buried by the east wall.

lines.zh: 活着的人不该问我这个。
lines.en: The living shouldn't ask me that.

lines.zh: 我夜里只和土说话。
lines.en: At night I speak only with the soil.

lines.zh: 同门之间，只交换沉默。
lines.en: Among us, we trade only silence.

lines.zh: 我给每座坟都留了位置。
lines.en: I've kept a place at every grave.

lines.zh: 这里的钟，敲的是丧钟。
lines.en: The bell here rings for funerals, not weddings.

lines.zh: 孤独是守夜人的工钱。
lines.en: Loneliness is the watchman's wage.

lines.zh: 我不需要谁陪着下葬。
lines.en: I need no one to be buried beside me.

lines.zh: 骨头我会收，别浪费。
lines.en: I'll take the bones. Nothing goes to waste.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指，是从坟里掉出来的。
lines.en: This ring slipped out of a grave.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的匕首，擦干净。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen dagger and wipe it.

lines.zh: 木牌上的名字，我抄下来。
lines.en: I copy down the name on the wooden marker.

lines.zh: 供品我会摆回原处。
lines.en: I'll put the offering back where it belongs.

lines.zh: 骨头归我，铁归你。
lines.en: The bones are mine; the iron is yours.

lines.zh: 我把烛台拾起来，火没灭。
lines.en: I lift the candlestick; the flame still lives.

lines.zh: 这些遗物，需要登记。
lines.en: These remains must be recorded.

lines.zh: 掘墓的铲子又丢了。
lines.en: The gravedigger's spade is missing again.

lines.zh: 捡起来的手，沾了泥。
lines.en: My hand, picking it up, is muddy.

lines.zh: 你踏进了不该来的地方。
lines.en: You've stepped where you shouldn't.

lines.zh: 那个村民，我要带走他。
lines.en: That villager. I'm taking him.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡挡在门口，正好。
lines.en: An iron golem in the doorway. Good.

lines.zh: 流浪商人的箱子，归墓园了。
lines.en: The trader's chest belongs to the graveyard now.

lines.zh: 三天不睡的人，会自己送上门。
lines.en: Those who don't sleep for three days come to me.

lines.zh: 我数过你的心跳了。
lines.en: I've counted your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 骨头匕首该见血了。
lines.en: The bone dagger should taste blood.

lines.zh: 同伴在墙后等着。
lines.en: My companions wait behind the wall.

lines.zh: 你踩到界线，就不能退了。
lines.en: You crossed the line; there's no going back.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只堵住出口。
lines.en: I don't chase; I block the exits.

lines.zh: 目标呼吸变快了，我听见了。
lines.en: The target's breathing quickened; I heard it.

lines.zh: 这只手已经握了太多骨头。
lines.en: This hand has held too many bones.

lines.zh: 掠夺者会从东边过来。
lines.en: The pillagers will come from the east.

lines.zh: 你要么躺下，要么离开。
lines.en: Either lie down or leave.

lines.zh: 墓园的门开了，我数到你了。
lines.en: The graveyard gate opens, and I have counted you.

lines.zh: 我绕着石碑走，挡住退路。
lines.en: I circle the headstones to cut off your retreat.

lines.zh: 匕首放低，我不急。
lines.en: Dagger low. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的护甲能挡两刀，够了。
lines.en: My armor stops two cuts. Enough.

lines.zh: 盾举得再高，脚还是露着。
lines.en: Raise the shield high; your feet still show.

lines.zh: 我数到七，你就该动了。
lines.en: I'll count to seven; then you should move.

lines.zh: 我的靴子不响，你听不出位置。
lines.en: My boots don't sound; you can't place me.

lines.zh: 土里伸出的手，会抓住你的脚。
lines.en: Hands from the soil will catch your feet.

lines.zh: 别回头看，那是我的人。
lines.en: Don't look back. Those are mine.

lines.zh: 你的甲在肩上有缝。
lines.en: Your armor has a seam at the shoulder.

lines.zh: 我在等你先挥剑。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to swing first.

lines.zh: 灯灭也没关系，我认得路。
lines.en: It doesn't matter if the lamp dies; I know the way.

lines.zh: 我从不后退，只换位置。
lines.en: I never retreat; I only change position.

lines.zh: 这一圈走完，就没有空隙了。
lines.en: When this circle closes, there's no gap left.

lines.zh: 你身后的碑，写的是你的名字。
lines.en: That stone behind you bears your name.

lines.zh: 我走在墓碑之间，比你熟路。
lines.en: I move between the headstones better than you do.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙后面是我们。
lines.en: You back to the wall, and we are behind it.

lines.zh: 三天没睡，你也该入教了。
lines.en: Three sleepless days—time to join us.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把会先灭。
lines.en: The torch in your hand will go out first.

lines.zh: 骨匕首划过，声音像刮石头。
lines.en: The bone dagger passes with a scrape of stone.

lines.zh: 这一刀，替你占好位置。
lines.en: This cut saves you a place.

lines.zh: 我刺向你护甲的缝隙。
lines.en: I thrust into the seam of your armor.

lines.zh: 你挡住上面，下面空了。
lines.en: You blocked high; the low is open.

lines.zh: 骨头割骨头，我不觉得疼。
lines.en: Bone cuts bone; I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我用手肘顶你，再补一刀。
lines.en: I drive an elbow in, then follow with the blade.

lines.zh: 你的血滴在碑上，很难洗。
lines.en: Your blood on the stone is hard to wash.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了下一刀。
lines.en: I gave half a step for the next cut.

lines.zh: 这一击不重，但会留疤。
lines.en: This blow is light, but it leaves a scar.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the bone crack?

lines.zh: 我劈下去，匕首卡在盾上。
lines.en: I chop down; the dagger lodges in your shield.

lines.zh: 别指望我停手。
lines.en: Don't expect me to stop.

lines.zh: 倒下的地方，我会记住。
lines.en: I'll remember where you fall.

lines.zh: 现在，你属于这座墓园了。
lines.en: Now you belong to this graveyard.

lines.zh: 匕首从下往上挑，冲着肋骨。
lines.en: The dagger comes up from below, aimed at ribs.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，刀已经进去了。
lines.en: I crash into your chest, and the blade is already in.

lines.zh: 第三个不眠夜，我来了。
lines.en: On the third sleepless night, I arrive.

lines.zh: 我从墓园的阴影里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the graveyard's shadow.

lines.zh: 身后跟着两个同伴。
lines.en: Two companions follow behind me.

lines.zh: 土是新的，我刚爬出来。
lines.en: The soil is fresh; I just climbed out.

lines.zh: 你数过自己几天没睡吗？
lines.en: Have you counted how many nights you've missed?

lines.zh: 掠夺者在墙外等你。
lines.en: The pillagers wait outside the wall.

lines.zh: 我带着堕落精华来收账。
lines.en: I come with fallen essence to collect.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，说明你还醒着。
lines.en: The lamp still burns; you're still awake.

lines.zh: 别喊，墓园不回声。
lines.en: Don't shout; the graveyard gives no echo.

lines.zh: 这一夜，轮到我来敲门。
lines.en: Tonight it's my turn to knock.

lines.zh: 骨匕首已经磨好了。
lines.en: The bone dagger is already honed.

lines.zh: 你连着三夜睁眼，我就在这。
lines.en: Three nights awake, and here I am.

lines.zh: 房子周围的路，我都走过。
lines.en: I've walked every path around your house.

lines.zh: 从今晚起，你归我管。
lines.en: From tonight, you're under my watch.

lines.zh: 火燎到袍子，我拍灭它。
lines.en: Flame catches my robe; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从墓道口摔下，骨头闷响。
lines.en: I fell down the crypt stair with a crack.

lines.zh: 水灌进墓穴，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water floods the crypt; I go under.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了三块石碑。
lines.en: The blast toppled three headstones.

lines.zh: 箭扎进骨甲，拔出来带渣。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in the bone armor; it comes out in splinters.

lines.zh: 法术的光让我的影子裂开。
lines.en: The spell's light splits my shadow.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也从不饿。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I'm never hungry.

lines.zh: 雷击在碑上，碑倒了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the stone, and it falls.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有坟，也没有名字。
lines.en: The void holds no graves and no names.
